name: Leopard 1
protection: Light steel armour for an MBT. Game: immune to all small arms incl. 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm on frontal arc; only launchers (Javelin, top-attack) or tank guns kill it; tandem-HEAT launchers (AT4 HEDP no, RPG-7 PG-7V only to sides/rear) can disable tracks, optics and side hull.
visual_notes: Cast turret with rounded sloped sides (1A5: bolted spaced armour blocks on turret front and sides, giving a wedge-like box look)
7 road wheels per side with rubber skirts
105 mm L7 gun with thermal sleeve and fume extractor
Low engine deck, stowage baskets at turret rear
